ἡμιονῖτις.definition: of or for a mule; mule-fern, Scolopendrium Hemionitis, Dsc.3.135

ἡνίσκος.definition: Dim. of II, small thong or strap, cj. in Herod.7.22

ἡμίαλφα.definition: half-alpha, a musical note, 𝉁, 𝉀, Alyp.4, al

ἡλιοκόμας.definition: with hair like the sun, Eust.976.53

ἡμέρωμα.definition: cultivated plant, Thphr.CP5.6.8 , prob. in HP1.7.1

ἡμίσπαστος.definition: half pulled down, Str.17.3.12; half torn away, AP10.21

ἡλιοφεγγής.definition: Dor. shining like the sun, Philod.Scarph.136

ἡρωίαμβος.definition: poem consisting of hexameters and iambics, Tz.H.4.868

ἡλιοδρόμος.definition: sun's messenger, Ramsay Cities and Bishoprics 2 p.566 ; title of a grade of initiates in Mithras-worship, Cumont Mystères de Mithra1.317

ἡμιοβόλιον.definition: half-obol weight, Paul.Aeg.3.29; in form on coins of Aegium, Head Hist.Num.2 413

ἡμικρανία.definition: pain on one side of the head or face, ib.592:—also PMag.Lond.121.199, Arch.f. Religionswiss.24.176

ἡρῷος.definition: contr. for ; the heroic measure, hexameter, Pl.R.400b, cf. Arist.Rh.1408b32; Id.Po.1460a3; dactyl, AP7.9 , etc

ἡμιτονιαῖος.definition: consisting of a semitone, Aristox.Harm.p.52M., Theo Sm.p.53H.; Ptol.Harm.2.9

ἡνιοχεύς.definition: Ep. poet. for Il.5.505; 312, cf. APl.5.337; the constellation Auriga, Nonn.D.1.178, al

ἡρωίνη.definition: fem. of heroine, Theoc.13.20; a deceased woman , CIG2259 , IG3.889; of a deified Empress, Jul.Caes.334b

ἡμίμηδος.definition: half a Mede, Oenom. ap. Eus.PE5.21

ἠθολογία.definition: painting of character, esp. by mimic gestures , Posidon. ap. Sen.Ep.95.65, Quint.1.9.3, Suet.Gramm.4

ἡμιαμβεῖον.definition: half-iambic line, i.e. catalectic dimeters, in pl., Cleanth.Stoic.1.129, Anacreont.tit

ἡμίνα.definition: half, Leg.Gort.2.49, SIG525.13; a Sicil. measure, = Epich.[290], Sophr.105; = Aristid.Or.49.32, cf. IG7.2712.66

ἠπιότης.definition: gentleness, Epicur.Fr.462, Hecat.Abd. ap. J.Ap.1.22, LXXEs.3.13 , Phld.Hom.p.33 O., Ph.2.267

ἠρεμάζω.definition: to be still, silent, esp. from grief, LXX2 Es.9.3

ἡλίασις.definition: = exposure to the sun, Gal.4.807 , D.C.59.7, Gp.7.1.3; sitting in the Jusj. ap. D.24.150

ἡμιγενής.definition: intermediate, equivocal, Pl.Ti.66d; of fruits, half-formed, Thphr.HP1.14.1

ἡμιζύγιος.definition: forming half a pair of scales, Arist.Mech.853b26

ἡσσητέος.definition: neut. pl. one must be beaten, by a woman, S.Ant.678, cf. Ar.Lys.450

ἠναντιωμένως.definition: Adv. pf. part. Pass., in opposite ways, Phld.Mus.p.103 K

ἡμιόνιον.definition: milt-wort, Asplenium Ceterach; Dim. of Str.5.3.6

ἡμερόω.definition: tame, make tame; prop. of wild beasts, Arist.HA488a29 , Gp.16.21.2; but simply, to be pacified, Pl.R.493b ; Id.Lg.906d

ἡμίνηρος.definition: contr. for half-fresh, and so of fish. half-salted, Xenocr.77, Ath.3.118f

ἡδύλογος.definition: of persons, flattering, fawning, E.Hec.132 : as Subst., jester, Ath.4.165b

ἠριγένεια.definition: early-born, child of; bearing in spring, A.Fr.426

ἡμιτέλεια.definition: remission of half the tribute, Luc.Nec.14

ἤπιος.definition: of heat and cold, mild, less intense, Pl.Phdr.279b, cf. Ti.85a ; of a fever, Hp.Epid.7.1; ib.5.73; Parm.8.57; of river-currents, MenoIatr.16.26

ἡμιπέρσης.definition: half a Persian, Oenom. ap. Eus.PE5.21

ἡβυλλιάω.definition: Comic Dim. of to be in the bloom of youth, Ar.Ra.516, Pherecr.108.29

ἡδυπαθής.definition: living pleasantly, enjoying oneself, luxurious, Antiph.91, Aristox.Fr.Hist.15

ἡρῷον.definition: tomb, IG12.478 , IGRom.4.799 , etc.:—in form CIG4418 , etc; hexameter, Plu.Num.4, etc

ἠπειρόω.definition: to make into mainland, opp. Arist.Mu.400a28; AP9.670:—Pass., to become so, Th.2.102, Ph.2.511

ἡμιπλήξ.definition: half-felled, of a tree, cleft, A.R.4.1683

ἤδη.definition: already, by this time, 'tis already night, Il.7.282; ib.402: with numerals, Od.2.89; Pl.Prt.309d; S.Ph.312; ib.354; Id.El.726; Id.Aj.1402

ἡμισελήνιον.definition: half the apparent breadth of the moon, Ptol.Alm.9.10

ἡμίδελτα.definition: half-delta, a musical note, 𝈵, Alyp.4, al

ἡπατῖτις.definition: of or in the liver; liver-coloured, Gp.6.6.2, Alex.Trall.7.6; hepatitis [gemma], Plin.HN37.186

ἡλιομαντεία.definition: magical invocation of the sun, PMag.Leid.W.4

ἡμίλιτρον.definition: in Sicily, half-obol, Arist.Fr.510; half-pound, Asclep. ap. Gal.13.445, al

ἡλιοσέληνος.definition: sunstone, imitatur quodammodo congressum solis etlunae, figuratque colore, Procl.de sacrificio et magia101

ἠλιθιάζω.definition: speak or act idly, foolishly, Ar.Eq.1124

ἡμιεκφανής.definition: half-brilliant, of stars of the lesser magnitudes, Ptol.Alm.7.1

ἡσυχάζω.definition: with or without a fallacy, Chrysipp.Stoic.2.8 , Gell.1.2.4; trans., bring to rest, Pl.R.572a

ἡλοκόπος.definition: nail-smith, BGU1028.19 , Judeich Altertümer von Hierapolis133; = Lat. clavarius, clavifixor, clavorum faber, Gloss

ἡδύπολις.definition: Dor. dear to the people, S.OT510

ἠχόπους.definition: gen. = Lat. sonipes, of horses, Eust.918.20

ἡδύποτος.definition: sweet to drink, Od.2.340, 3.391, etc.; also of a cup, Philol. 72.547

ἤθησις.definition: riddling, IG4.1485.124 ; prob. l. for Arist.Pr.870b18

ἠθογραφέω.definition: paint or describe character, Marcellin.Vit. Thuc.50

ἠπιαλέω.definition: have a fever or ague, Ar.Ach.1165 , Arist.Pr.947b21

ἡμίκεντρος.definition: half-way between cardinal points, prob. in Jul.Laod.inCat.Cod.Astr.5.190

ἠγάθεος.definition: Dor. most holy, of places immediately under divine protection, Il.1.252, 2.722; Hes.Th.499, Pi.P.9.71; A.R.3.981, 4.1131

ἦξις.definition: coming, v.l. for in E.Tr.396 ap. AB99

ἡμιωριαῖος.definition: lasting half an hour: neut. as Subst., Phlp.in Ph.802.15

ἠρεμί.definition: Adv. for Ar.Ra.315, v.l. in Aristaenet.1.22

ἡρωολογία.definition: tale of heroes, title of work by Anaximander, Ath.11.498b

ἡμερεύω.definition: spend the day, X.HG5.4.3; pass one's days, S.El.787:—Med., dub. l. in E.Fr.812.6

ἡνωμένως.definition: Adv.pf.part. Pass., in one word , Procl.in Prm.p.525S.; in a unity, Id.in Euc.p.138 F., Dam.Pr.1; together, HeroGeom.12.53

ἡλικιάζομαι.definition: Pass., assume this or that quality, dub. in Herm. ap. Stob.1.49.69

ἡμισεύω.definition: halve, LXXPs.54.24, Aq.Ge. 33.1; boil down to one half, Hippiatr.2
